jobs.title: Data Analyst - Supply Chain & Operations
jobs.description:
About Us

Founded in 1988, Marketech International Corp. (MIC) is a global technology and engineering company supporting semiconductor, high-tech manufacturing, and mission-critical facility projects. MIC provides turnkey facility integration solutions, including cleanroom and MEP construction, DI water, gas and chemical supply systems, wastewater treatment, facility monitoring and control systems, installation, and maintenance services. Through Marketech International Corporation USA, we support major semiconductor and industrial projects across the United States.

Job Overview

Marketech International Corporation USA is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst - Supply Chain & Operations to support data-driven decision-making across supply chain, procurement, project management, and operational functions.

This position is responsible for collecting, organizing, validating, analyzing, and presenting business and operational data from multiple sources. The Data Analyst will develop reports and dashboards, monitor key performance indicators, identify trends and discrepancies, and translate complex information into clear and actionable insights for management and cross-functional teams.

The ideal candidate is a quick learner with strong analytical and communication skills, advanced Microsoft Excel capabilities, and experience working with supply chain or operational data. Experience with Power BI and/or Tableau, as well as SQL, Python, or similar data-analysis tools, is required. Fluency in Chinese and English is required due to regular interaction with internal and external stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Collect, consolidate, and analyze data from ERP systems, procurement records, inventory reports, project trackers, finance records, and other operational sources.
Prepare recurring and ad-hoc reports to support management and departmental decision-making.
Develop and maintain meaningful metrics and KPIs for supply chain, procurement, project, and operational performance.
Create and maintain dashboards, reports, charts, and visualizations using Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
Build and improve Excel-based reporting tools using formulas, PivotTables, charts, Power Query, and other data-analysis features.
Analyze purchasing, inventory, materials, suppliers, orders, lead times, costs, delivery performance, and operational trends.
Identify shortages, delays, variances, data discrepancies, and potential operational risks; communicate findings to the appropriate teams.
Support supplier-performance tracking, material-availability reporting, cost analysis, and operational planning.
Review data for accuracy, completeness, and consistency across multiple sources and coordinate with departments to resolve discrepancies.
Support forecasting, trend analysis, variance analysis, and continuous-improvement initiatives related to reporting and business processes.
Document data sources, metric definitions, reporting procedures, and recurring report requirements.
Collaborate with supply chain, procurement, engineering, project management, operations, finance, and other departments to understand business needs.
Present analytical findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Respond to ad-hoc data requests, manage competing priorities, and provide timely analytical support in a fast-paced environment.
Support communication with Chinese- and English-speaking internal and external stakeholders as needed.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Supply Chain Management, Statistics, Finance, Business Administration, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field preferred.
Minimum of 1 year of experience in data analysis, supply chain, procurement, operations, business analytics, or a related field.
Bilingual in Chinese and English due to communication requirements with internal and external stakeholders.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas and functions, XLOOKUP or INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, PivotTables, charts, data organization, and analysis.
Experience with Power BI and/or Tableau.
Experience with SQL, Python, or another data-analysis tool is required.
Basic knowledge of statistics, data analysis principles, and data visualization best practices.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills.
Ability to identify trends, investigate discrepancies, and communicate findings clearly.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Ability to manage multiple reporting requests and priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience analyzing supply chain, procurement, inventory, logistics, supplier, materials, or operational data.
Experience developing dashboards, KPIs, management reports, and recurring reporting processes.
Experience with ERP or business systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar platforms.
Familiarity with semiconductor, high-tech manufacturing, engineering, construction, logistics, or other technical industries.
Experience working with large, complex, or multi-source datasets.
Familiarity with Power Query, DAX, data modeling, database structures, or basic forecasting methods.
Experience supporting process improvement, reporting standardization, or data-governance initiatives.

Technical Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:

Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas, PivotTables, charts, Power Query, and data-cleaning workflows
Power BI, Tableau, or other business-intelligence and data-visualization platforms
SQL querying, data extraction, joins, filtering, and aggregation
Python, pandas, or similar tools for data cleaning, analysis, and automation
ERP, procurement, inventory, materials-management, logistics, or project-management systems
Supply chain, supplier, purchasing, inventory, cost, delivery, lead-time, and operational performance data
KPI development, dashboard design, trend analysis, variance analysis, and management reporting
Data validation, reconciliation, documentation, and reporting-process improvement

Work Environment

This is a full-time, on-site position in Phoenix, Arizona, supporting semiconductor, engineering, construction, operational, and corporate business environments. The position is primarily office-based and requires regular interaction with project teams, customers, vendors, subcontractors, and company leadership.

Occasional visits to semiconductor manufacturing facilities, construction sites, customer locations, or other active project environments may be required. The Data Analyst must be comfortable working at a computer for extended periods, handling confidential business and operational data, attending meetings, managing changing priorities, and supporting multiple departments in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Occasional local travel and the ability to lift or move office materials, project documents, or supplies weighing up to 20 pounds may be required.

Benefits

100% paid benefits for the employee, including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
Paid Time Off (PTO)
401(k) plan

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Marketech International Corporation USA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, regulation, or ordinance.

jobs.description:
Join us as a Business Analyst at Barclays, where you will play a key role in driving strategic change and business transformation across the organisation. You will partner with business and technology stakeholders to identify opportunities, define business requirements, design operating models and deliver innovative solutions that support Barclays' strategic objectives while ensuring robust risk management and governance.

To be successful as a Business Analyst, you should have experience with:

Strong experience in business analysis, requirements elicitation, and requirements management
Expertise in translating complex business challenges into executable business and technology solutions
Experience in process design, operational design, and target operating model development
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior business and technology leaders
Experience in business case development, feasibility assessments, and solution evaluation
Knowledge of change management practices, including requirements traceability and benefits realization
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience evaluating multiple solution options and recommendations
Experience managing risks, controls, and governance requirements within business change initiatives
Ability to create and present clear and concise documentation, reports, and strategic recommendations
Experience working across cross-functional teams to deliver business outcomes

Ability to contribute to strategy development and drive business transformation initiatives

Excellent communication, negotiation, and influencing skills

The role is based out of Pune.

Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.

To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.

Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

IMI plc

We are a global specialist engineering company that creates breakthrough solutions. We are curious and like to solve problems, partnering with our customers to solve the demands of today and prepare for the challenges of tomorrow. We embrace innovation and care about outcomes that are good for business, everyday life and making a better world – creating lasting impact for everyone.

We design, build and service highly engineered products in fluid and motion control applications. We focus on five market sectors: Industrial Automation, Process Automation, Climate Control, Life Science and Fluid Control, and Transport.

Role Overview

This role is responsible for planning element of the tender review, planning for orders from customer order receipt to delivery.

This is a critical role within IMI Poole and responsible for monitoring and ensuring the cost of projects are maintained within budget. They will ensure that each project is capable of delivering the businesses margin targets and that resource holders are aware of slippages to achieve on time delivery.

The post holder will be required to evaluate, as part of the tender review process, the technical and commercial elements of a sales enquiry to ascertain the necessity for projects involvement; producing project plans for contract/orders where they are the point of contact for both the business and customer.

Key Responsibilities

Duties will include but not be limited to:

Evaluate all technical and commercial elements of a sales enquiry; developing a project plan.
Produce proposals resulting from enquiries arising from the Sales team’s activities. This will include the following:
Estimates of time required to undertake design and manufacturing of the solutions proposed.
Taking a lead in identifying and managing risks throughout the quotation process and liaising with various other colleagues as required to perform risk mitigation tasks.
Undertaking and producing reports on margin analysis against planned delivery.
Occasionally accompanying the sales team or delivering proposal presentations and contract reviews at the customer’s site. This may include international travel.
Act as the customer interface for the duration of a project/order/contract giving the customer regular status reports (some contractual) or dealing with the customer on issues with the project/order/contract.
Participate in customer visits/quality reviews to final product acceptance.
Develop and maintain key account management relationship with the customers.
Ensure that the customer order/quotation have been reviewed for export compliance.
Deliver a written report on a weekly basis status of projects.
Produce project plans, which are regularly updated and issued to the team involved in meeting the customer’s delivery schedule.
Call regular project meetings, taking the minutes and ensuring action are maintained, escalating if delivery is not maintained.
Manage a robust process that tracks project margin throughout the project execution to ensure margins are maintained, and mitigation plans developed with functional leaders are delivered.
Use the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) process to maintain project status and costs and support the production planning process.
Work alongside the Design and Sales teams to provide technical assistance to help increase sales revenues.
Prioritise the activities in the defined pre-production route to the point of release to manufacture.
Maintain customer delivery status through liaison with elements of the business and communicate with customers as necessary.
Develop a weekly project progress report that details timeliness, margin status, cost to complete and risks.
Receive, translate and resolve technical enquiries with engineering support.
Perform other such duties commensurate with the nature and level of the post as may be reasonably required.

Critical Competencies for Success

Qualified to HNC or bachelor’s degree level (or equivalent) in a related discipline. This academic knowledge may then have been applied in different roles including sales, projects or design.
Demonstrable experience in Project Management; Analysis; Design Skills; Manufacturing Methods and Procedures; Process Improvement; Technical Understanding; Documentation Skills; Supervision; CAD; CAD/CAM Design.
Excellent technical expertise with experience of production processes and product quality requirements including welding, NDT and component manufacture.

The RISE Project Manager serves as a member of the Office of the Vice Chancellor for Research (OVCR) Research Development team. The OVCR will establish three RISE Project Manager positions to support UW–Madison's Research, Innovation, and Scholarly Excellence (RISE) themes: Artificial Intelligence (AI), Environment: Adaptation, Resilience, Technology, and Humanity (EARTH), and Health and Well-Being (THRIVE). Each RISE Project Manager will be assigned primary responsibility for supporting one RISE theme and will serve as the principal project management and coordination resource for initiatives and activities within that theme.

The RISE Project Manager will work closely with the RISE HQ Lead, RISE initiative leadership, and faculty leaders to advance strategic priorities, interdisciplinary research activities, stakeholder engagement efforts, and implementation goals. The position will receive ongoing direction regarding priorities within the assigned RISE theme and support the successful execution of related initiatives and activities.

Collectively, the three positions provide project management, coordination, and implementation support for strategic RISE priorities and initiatives. While each position serves as the primary liaison for its assigned RISE theme, incumbents may contribute a limited portion of their effort to broader OVCR strategic priorities, research development activities, and emerging institutional initiatives as organizational needs evolve.

The RISE Project Manager manages multiple concurrent projects from initiation through completion. The position serves as a strategic connector, facilitator, and project management resource responsible for coordinating interdisciplinary initiatives, supporting collaboration among faculty and stakeholders, developing and monitoring project plans, managing timelines and deliverables, and advancing strategic priorities established by RISE and OVCR leadership.

new_jobs.title: L&D Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
At Algolia, we’re proud to be a pioneer and market leader in AI Search, empowering 18,000+ businesses to deliver blazing-fast, predictive search and browse experiences at internet scale. Every week, we power over 30 billion search requests — four times more than Microsoft Bing, Yahoo, Baidu, Yandex, and DuckDuckGo combined.

In 2021, we raised $150 million in Series D funding, quadrupling our valuation to $2.25 billion. This strong foundation enables us to keep investing in our market-leading platform and serving incredible customers like Under Armour, PetSmart, Stripe, Gymshark, and Walgreens.

We’re looking for someone who combines the mindset of a consultant, the discipline of a strong program leader and operator, and a genuine passion for creating a great employee experience.

This role is for someone who is naturally curious about how things work—and how they could work better. You’ll look across employee feedback, processes, systems, and stakeholder experiences to identify friction, diagnose root causes, and design thoughtful, scalable solutions.

Initially, you’ll focus on three critical areas of the employee lifecycle: onboarding, employee listening, and engagement. You’ll partner closely with teams across People, Talent Acquisition, IT, Workplace, and the business to understand needs, bring structure to complex or ambiguous problems, and improve the experiences employees and managers have at Algolia.

You won’t just execute existing processes. You’ll help shape the strategy behind them, lead programs from discovery through implementation, and continuously ask: What problem are we trying to solve? What are employees actually experiencing? Where is friction showing up? What does the data tell us? And how can we create something that works better for both employees and the business?

Success in this role means creating employee experiences that feel thoughtful, human, and connected while building the structure, processes, and operating discipline needed to make those experiences scalable and sustainable.

What You’ll Do

Employee Listening & Insights

Own the execution and evolution of Algolia’s employee listening strategy, including engagement, pulse, onboarding, exit, and other lifecycle surveys.
Turn employee feedback into meaningful insights by identifying trends, themes, risks, and opportunities.
Combine quantitative data with qualitative feedback to understand what is happening and why.
Develop clear narratives and recommendations that help leaders move from data to action.
Partner with leaders and People Business Partners to understand what sits behind the data and determine where deeper discovery may be needed.
Create reporting, communications, action-planning resources, and follow-up mechanisms that make employee feedback useful—not simply informational.
Establish thoughtful processes that create a consistent and scalable approach to employee listening.
Evaluate the effectiveness of listening programs and continuously improve how we collect, interpret, and act on feedback.

Onboarding Experience

Own and continuously improve the end-to-end onboarding experience, from pre-boarding through the first 90 days.
Assess the new hire journey across systems, communications, learning, manager touchpoints, community, and workplace experiences to identify friction and opportunities.
Partner across Talent Acquisition, People Operations, IT, Workplace, Learning & Development, and business teams to create a coordinated experience.
Use onboarding feedback, operational metrics, stakeholder input, and employee insights to prioritize improvements.
Design experiences that help new hires build clarity, connection, confidence, and productivity more quickly.
Establish clear ownership and workflows across the many teams involved in onboarding.
Identify opportunities to simplify and automate onboarding processes without losing the human moments that matter.

Design Better Processes And Experiences

Evaluate existing employee experience processes and identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, redesign, or automate them.
Conduct discovery with employees, managers, and stakeholders to understand needs, pain points, and lived experiences before designing solutions.
Build clear, scalable workflows with defined ownership, decision points, handoffs, documentation, and measures of success.
Balance employee needs, business requirements, and operational realities when designing solutions.
Translate strategy into practical execution plans while maintaining a strong focus on the employee experience.
Build feedback loops into programs so employee and stakeholder input continuously informs how experiences evolve.
Establish mechanisms for continuously evaluating whether programs and processes are delivering the intended experience.

What We’re Looking For

A deeply employee-centered mindset, with strong empathy, active listening skills, and curiosity about how processes, systems, communications, and decisions are experienced by employees.
A process-oriented mindset with experience designing, improving, and operationalizing workflows and programs.
Strong program and project management skills, including the ability to define scope, prioritize work, manage timelines, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder accountability.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to take an ambiguous challenge, diagnose root causes, and create a structured path forward.
Strong analytical judgment, including the ability to combine quantitative data with qualitative insights to identify patterns and make recommendations.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear insights, recommendations, and decisions.
Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills, including the ability to build trust, navigate competing perspectives, and influence without authority.
A continuous improvement mindset and curiosity about how technology, AI, and automation can make work both more efficient and more human.
Comfort operating in environments where the answer or process may not yet exist.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in creating people strategy and an eagerness to improve employee engagement, connection & belonging
Experience with employee listening, onboarding, engagement, or lifecycle programs.
Experience leading initiatives that require coordination across multiple teams, perspectives and priorities
Experience with Lattice, Seismic, or similar tools
Experience supporting global or distributed organizations
Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity tools and workflow automation

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will:

Become a trusted thought partner who helps the People team diagnose employee experience challenges and turn them into practical solutions.
Deliver employee experience programs with strong project discipline, clear ownership, effective stakeholder alignment, and measurable outcomes.
Build a more consistent, intentional, and measurable onboarding experience that improves new hire clarity, connection, readiness, and engagement.
Establish an employee listening approach that moves beyond reporting results to generating insights and driving meaningful action.
Improve or redesign key employee experience processes so that ownership, workflows, and expectations are clearer and easier to navigate.
Simplify and automate manual processes where technology can improve the experience without sacrificing important human touchpoints.
Build strong partnerships across People, Talent Acquisition, IT, Workplace, and the business.
Create repeatable ways of using data, employee feedback, and stakeholder input to continuously improve the employee experience.
Be known for bringing both rigor and empathy to the work—creating solutions that work operationally and feel better for employees.

Algolia does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, military status, veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The annual base salary compensation range for this role reflects market pay data within this location. The exact compensation offered for this role may vary depending on specific location and job-related knowledge, technical skills, and experience; and is only one part of our Total Rewards philosophy to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

Base Salary Pay Range

$100,000—$110,000 USD

Flexible Workplace Strategy

Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when.

We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees. Positions listed as "Remote" are only available for remote work within the specified country. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule.

WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO CAN LIVE OUR VALUES:

GRIT - Problem-solving and perseverance capability in an ever-changing and growing environment.
TRUST - Willingness to trust our co-workers and to take ownership.
CANDOR - Ability to receive and give constructive feedback.
CARE - Genuine care about other team members, our clients and the decisions we make in the company.
HUMILITY - Aptitude for learning from others, putting ego aside.

We’re looking for talented, passionate people to help build the world’s best search and discovery technology. We value autonomy, diversity, and collaboration. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and supported—regardless of race, age, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, color, veteran status, disability, or socioeconomic background.

READY TO APPLY?

As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive, and growth-focused environment for our people.

About This Team

The Global Procurement team are trusted business advisors who strategically partner with internal stakeholders and external suppliers to create value and mitigate risk in strategic non-product purchases for the global organization. The team supports the business in increasing its profitability and return on investment by creating value in our indirect supply chain through strategic & stakeholder-centric procurement. From providing category expertise, market insights, cost savings opportunities, supplier performance and relationship management & developing short and long-term strategies, the Global Procurement team plays a key role in value delivery for our business.

Rooted within Global Procurement is the Global Procurement Strategy & Analytics function. This team enables value delivery across Category Management through Procurement Enablement, Procurement Intelligence, and Responsible Procurement. Beyond establishing strong data and process foundations, the team also drives alignment to lululemon’s core values and mandates related to People and Planet.

a Day In The Life

Reporting to the Director, Procurement – Strategy & Analytics, the Program Manager, Risk and Supplier Relationship Management (Responsible Procurement) plays a critical role in embedding lululemon’s values across our supplier ecosystem. In close partnership with Legal, Risk & Advisory, Cybersecurity, and Business Units, this role leads the design and execution of global Responsible Procurement programs focused on supplier risk and relationship management within Global Procurement.

Translate risk and relationship management frameworks into scalable processes, tools, and governance, enabling consistent adoption across categories and regions
Own program outcomes, ensuring risk assessments, monitoring, and supplier relationship activities are executed with rigor, consistency, and timeliness

Drive continuous improvement across tools, processes, and data, strengthening program effectiveness, scalability, and usability

Preferred: MBA, SCMP, PMP or other relevant professional designation or certification
5+ years Procurement experience, Third-party Risk Management, Supplier Relationship Management programs and/or Procurement Strategy
2+ years of indirect procurement category experience
Data-driven thinker with proven ability to analyze complex data
Excellent PC skills (Microsoft Office); experience with P2P (Coupa) or Oracle is an asset
Experience using AI to unlock efficiency and fuel analytics. P2P/e-sourcing platform knowledge is an asset
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Core capabilities:

Responsible Procurement: Ensures strategic sourcing integrates supplier risk and relationship and performance considerations.
Reporting: Creates and manages updates to procurement reports, including but not limited to spend reporting, contract analysis and reporting, project landscape reporting, supplier attributes reporting.
Data Management: Has a strong proficiency with procurement systems and tools.
Project management: Leads complex projects and manages multiple deliverables concurrently. Uses tools and techniques to track progress, manage risks, and proactively communicate changes.
Supplier Risk: Advanced understanding of third-party risk management principles. Develops risk management requirements, reviews assessments, defines monitoring strategies required across all supplier tiers along with management of risk register

ESG: Integrates social and environmental concerns into Procurement practices. Guides others in policy and/or direction within procurement activities.

Communicate with honesty and kindness and create the space for others to do the same.
Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure.

About Digital Transformation

Digital Transformation is a multi-year enterprise initiative focused on standardizing business processes, creating a digital core, improving data quality, enabling AI-driven insights, and deploying scalable technology platforms across the organization. Key initiatives include Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Quality Management Systems (QMS), and enterprise data modernization efforts.

The impact you’ll make

The Digital Transformation (DT) Program Manager will lead strategic transformation initiatives focused on Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and related business process modernization. This role is responsible for driving the successful delivery of complex, cross-functional programs from planning through deployment, ensuring alignment with business objectives, digital transformation roadmaps, and enterprise architecture standards.

The Program Manager will partner with business stakeholders, IT, solution architects, vendors, and PMO leadership to design, implement, and optimize scalable business processes and technology solutions. The role requires strong program leadership, business process expertise, stakeholder management, change leadership, and execution excellence in a global environment.

What You’ll Do

Program Leadership & Delivery
Lead large-scale Digital Transformation initiatives from initiation through deployment and stabilization.
Develop and manage integrated program plans, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and resource requirements.
Coordinate execution across business functions, technology teams, vendors, and external partners.
Manage program risks, issues, decisions, assumptions, and dependencies (RAID).
Ensure projects are delivered on schedule, within scope, and within budget.
Drive deployment readiness, cutover planning, hypercare, and transition to support organizations.

Stakeholder Management & Governance

Serve as the primary point of contact for program status, escalation management, and executive communication.
Prepare and present program updates for Steering Committees, Operating Committees, and PMO governance forums.
Facilitate decision-making and alignment across business functions and technology teams.
Partner with senior leaders to prioritize scope, resources, and delivery objectives.

About Nebius

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

The role

We are seeking a highly technical and experienced Network Planning Technical Project Manager to join our infrastructure team. In this pivotal role, you will be the bridge between internal data center development teams and external telecommunications partners.

You will own the connectivity lifecycle—from initial site opportunity assessment through to the final Outside Plant infrastructure delivery—ensuring our facilities are seamlessly integrated into the global network.

The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of fiber optics, ISP commercial structures, and geospatial data management, coupled with the project management discipline to drive complex, multi-stakeholder builds across the region.

You’re welcome to work remotely from APAC region.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategy

Integrated Project Delivery: Work in lock-step with other Network TPMs, DWDM engineers, ITDC (Infrastructure Technical Data Center) teams, Network Procurement, and Construction departments to ensure cohesive project execution.
Datacenters PoP Selection: Partner with the site selection team to evaluate connectivity feasibility. Lead the technical validation of long-haul wave proposals and dark fiber options to inform Datacenter and PoP selections.
Infrastructure Design: Act as the technical lead for fiber pathway architecture from the "0 manhole" to the internal access panels. Oversee the design of manhole placements, conduit systems, and site entry points to ensure optimal route diversity.
MMR/POE Integration: Collaborate with engineering teams on the layout of Point of Entry (POE) and Meet-Me Rooms (MMR), ensuring space, power, and structural readiness for high-capacity, multi-carrier fiber and MOFN (Managed Optical Fiber Network) arrivals.

Carrier Relations & Commercial Management

Strategic Partnerships: Build and maintain strategic relationships with regional/ Continental ISPs, private dark fiber owners, and utility providers.
Procurement & Negotiation: Collaborate with Network Procurement on RFx process for last-mile, middle-mile, and long-haul capacity. Lead negotiations for IRU (Indefeasible Right of Use) agreements, long-term leases, and MOFN service structures.
Colocation: Coordinate with fiber owners to secure necessary rack space, power, and environmental resources within ILA (Inline Amplification) sites.

Network Data & Geospatial Management

Documentation: Maintain internal databases of fiber/connectivity routes, including rigorous management of KMZ/KML files.
AutoCAD: Utilize AutoCAD to review, modify, and create site infrastructure and conduit design plans, ensuring accurate documentation of physical plant deployments.

We Expect You To Have

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
Industry Expertise: 5+ years of experience in network infrastructure, OSP planning, or data center connectivity project management.
Technical Proficiency: AutoCAD: Proficiency in creating and reviewing site infrastructure/conduit designs.
GIS: Advanced ability to work with geospatial tools and KMZ/KML files.
Optical Networking: Strong grasp of DWDM technology, ILA requirements, and the technical lifecycle of MOFN deployments.
Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated success in negotiating complex fiber leases, IRUs, and construction contracts.
Relationship Management: Proven ability to influence stakeholders and external vendors to meet aggressive regional deployment timelines.

Preferred Technical Stack

Deep knowledge of the regional fiber landscape, including utility right-of-way and regional infrastructure challenges.
Experience with large-scale 100Tbps+ capacity planning and deployment.
Ability to read and create code in Python or Go that is relevant to the position.
Knowledge of service provider or datacenter IP Networking is preferred.

Competitive compensation
Career growth and learning opportunities
Flexibility and ownership
Collaborative and innovative culture
Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

new_jobs.description:
Information Security Manager

Department:
Technology
Reports to:
VP, Technology (David Crandall)

None initially (program is MSP-backed — Paragus co-managed SOC)
Primary location:
Boston or Chicago metro preferred; Columbus, OH (Dublin/Kinetics hub), HYBRID

About Catalyst Acoustics Group

Catalyst Acoustics Group (CAG) is a mid-market manufacturer of noise-control and vibration control products, operating a family of brands (Kinetics Noise Control, Sound Seal, IAC Acoustics, Frasch, Lamvin, Noise Barriers, RealAcoustix, Madrid, CurbTech, and Riverbank Acoustical Laboratories) across roughly a dozen U.S. sites, with the Dublin, OH Kinetics campus as our technology hub. We run a cloud-first Microsoft 365 / Azure environment backed by a managed security provider (Paragus). Security is being established as its own dedicated function within Technology.

Role summary

We are seeking an Information Security Manager — a hands-on player-coach who will both run the security program and do the operational security work. This is the senior owner of CAG's information-security function: you set the roadmap, governance, and reporting, and you also personally respond to incidents, tune the tooling, and work the queue. It is a single-owner role (no direct reports at the outset), leveraging our managed provider (Paragus co-managed SOC) for scale rather than an internal team.

This role is the permanent successor to CAG's summer security internship, which concludes in August 2026. It assumes senior ownership of the three functions the intern ran day-to-day — security ticket triage, the KnowBe4 awareness program, and Huntress EDR response — and adds the program governance, risk/compliance, and leadership reporting that a manager owns. A clean handoff package from the intern will be available.

You will report to the VP, Technology and partner across IT, HR, Operations, and the brands, plus manage security vendors and the co-managed SOC relationship.

Scope covers IT and information security across CAG’s cloud-first Microsoft 365 / Azure environment; operational-technology (OT) systems on the plant floor are addressed in partnership with Operations.

Essential functions

Program ownership (the “manager” half)

Own and drive CAG's information-security roadmap and priorities across all brands and sites.
Develop and maintain security policy, standards, and governance; drive toward a defined baseline (e.g., change management, access governance, IR plan approved by the ELT).
Own risk and compliance: risk register, control gaps, vulnerability-management program cadence, annual penetration-test coordination, and remediation tracking.
Own the security awareness program (KnowBe4): training assignment/completion, monthly phishing-simulation campaigns, targeted remediation with HR, and metrics.
Manage security vendors and tooling — including the Paragus co-managed SOC relationship, EDR, and email security — holding them to scope and outcomes.
Report to leadership: regular security posture, KPIs, incident summaries, and risk readouts for the VP, Technology and the ELT.
Lead security due diligence and integration for CAG acquisitions — assess acquired environments and fold them into CAG’s security baseline.
Own cyber-insurance renewal attestations and respond to customer and contractual security questionnaires and audits.
Own or co-own business continuity and disaster-recovery planning, including backup-integrity validation and recovery testing.
Contribute the security lens to the multi-brand ERP consolidation and other major technology projects (access model, segregation of duties, secure design).

Hands-on operations (the “player” half)

Incident response — lead investigation, containment, and resolution; own the IR runbooks and post-incident reviews; escalate to the VP, Technology as appropriate; available for reasonable after-hours response to high-severity incidents.
EDR (Huntress) — monitor and triage the alert queue, validate and classify alerts, respond to standard types, tune detections, and drive novel/high-severity cases to closure.
Email security (Mimecast) — administer the platform, manage quarantine and policy, and respond to email-borne threats.
Identity & M365 security — MFA/Conditional Access, privileged-access and elevated-permission governance, Defender/Entra security posture, and account-compromise response.
Phishing response — own end-user phishing reports and “is this safe?” triage in Zoho Desk, applying and improving the playbooks.
Vulnerability management — run/coordinate regular scans, prioritize findings, and drive patching/remediation to closure.

Qualifications

Required

5+ years in information security with a mix of hands-on operations and program/leadership responsibility — able to both run the program and do the work directly. (Hands-on technical depth is weighted over policy-only backgrounds, per leadership direction.)
Direct experience with incident response and EDR tooling (Huntress, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, or similar).
Microsoft 365 / Entra (Azure AD) security depth: MFA/Conditional Access, privileged access, Defender.
Email security administration (Mimecast, Proofpoint, or similar).
Vulnerability management and remediation experience.
Experience owning or heavily contributing to a security awareness program (KnowBe4 or similar).
Ability to set policy/governance and to report security posture to executive leadership.
Strong written and verbal communication; can translate risk for non-technical stakeholders.
Authorization to work in the United States.
Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, information systems, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred

Security certifications (CISSP, CISM, GIAC, or CompTIA Security+/CySA+) are a plus but not required.
Experience managing a co-managed SOC / MSSP relationship.
Manufacturing or multi-site / multi-entity (incl. post-acquisition) environment.
Familiarity with our stack: Huntress, Mimecast, KnowBe4, Microsoft Defender/Entra, Zoho Desk, Intune.

What success looks like (first 6–12 months)

Clean assumption of the three intern-run functions (ticket triage, KnowBe4, Huntress) with a clean transition from the intern’s coverage and interim arrangements in place as needed.
A published security roadmap and baseline policy set, with an ELT-approved incident-response plan.
A running cadence: vulnerability scans, awareness campaigns, and a monthly security readout to leadership.
The Paragus co-managed SOC relationship actively managed to defined outcomes.

Join Barclays as a Technology Change Project Manager
and play a pivotal role in driving large-scale transformation initiatives across technology and financial crime programmes. You will lead complex change delivery, coordinate cross-functional teams, and ensure strategic outcomes are achieved while enhancing operational effectiveness and supporting business objectives.

This role operates within Integrated Financial Crime (IFC), a function dedicated to driving a safer and stronger Barclays through effective financial crime prevention, risk management, and technology-enabled solutions.

To be successful as a Technology Change Project Manager
, you should have experience with:

Proven experience in large scale Project mgmt. and delivery transformation – delivering complex programmes on time while driving measurable business outcomes
Experience working in and understanding of the financial crime landscape – enabling effective delivery of regulatory and financial crime change initiatives
Experience in delivering change and Agile ways of working – supporting adaptive delivery models and continuous value creation

Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include

A continuous improvement and change mindset, with a focus on delivering process optimisation, control effectiveness, and sustainable solutions
Experience managing complex dependencies across business, ops & technology teams while maintaining project governance
Ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders across Business, Technology, Operations, Architecture, Data, Risk, Compliance, and senior leadership teams

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is based in Knutsford or Glasgow.

Purpose of the role

Focused on delivering individual projects, ensuring completion within scope, time, and budget with a more immediate focus.

Accountabilities

Scope Management: Manages a single project with specific, defined objectives, deadlines, and deliverables. Their focus is on completing the project on time, within scope, and on budget.
Strategic Focus: Operates more tactically, focusing on day-to-day management of resources, schedules, and deliverables for their individual project.
Time Horizon: Works with a shorter, more defined timeframe as projects have a set beginning and end.
Stakeholder Management: Primarily manages stakeholders related to their specific project, ensuring communication and expectations are clear for the project’s deliverables.
Risk and Issue Management: Focuses on risks and issues specific to their project and works to mitigate them within the project’s scope.
Resource Management: Manages resources for their individual project, ensuring that the project team has the necessary skills, tools, and time to complete the work.
Financial Management: Focuses on managing the budget of their specific project, ensuring it is completed within the financial constraints.
Metrics: Measures success based on the timely completion of project deliverables within scope, time, and budget.
Change Management: Manages changes that directly impact their specific project, including scope changes, timelines, or resource allocation adjustments.

Vice President Expectations

To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. new_jobs.description:
Application Opening:

Application Deadline:

Recruitment ID:
166389; RTF0168017-01134430

Appointment Type

This is a Category 18 Permanent Exempt position, special project-based position limited to no more than 3 years in duration. This position is excluded by the Charter from the competitive Civil Service examination process, is considered "at will" and shall serve at the discretion of the Department Head.

The San Francisco Public Library (SFPL) connects our diverse communities to learning, opportunities, and each other. The library system includes the architecturally significant Main Library, an anchor institution in the city's Civic Center, 27 neighborhood branch libraries that serve all neighborhoods throughout the city, two administrative buildings and four bookmobiles. With a collection of more than 5 million physical and digital items circulating 15 million times annually, SFPL is the highest-rated City department in San Francisco.

The library embraces its role as the most democratic of institutions, providing safe and welcoming facilities for all. Through a robust array of services and programs that serves 4.6 million patrons annually, the library is dedicated to advancing literacy and learning, serving as a cultural amplifier, acting as a catalyst for community engagement, guiding patrons as a thoughtful navigator, and providing essential resources to support healthy, equitable communities. For more information about SFPL, please visit www.sfpl.org.

SFPL must build a culture, space and workplace that is accessible and welcoming to all current and future employees and to actively build an environment in which all people regardless of background, identity, or ability, can be equal participants. In this way, our staff at all organizational levels can reflect the communities we serve. A safe, equitable public library is an actively anti-racist public library. Creating an inclusive public library means aligning with the lived realities of people of color. SFPL is committed to advancing racial equity for our workforce and community, and will actively engage in anti-racist practice programs, and collection development in carrying out the Library's mission.

Role description

This position serves as SFPL’s lead professional responsible for developing, implementing, and sustaining the Library’s systemwide emergency planning and security program. Operating at a high analytical and operational level, the position provides subject matter expertise, independent judgment, and cross departmental coordination to ensure SFPL’s 30 facilities, staff, and patrons are prepared for and protected during emergencies.

Major functions include conducting comprehensive emergency and security assessments, updating and standardizing emergency plans and procedures, evaluating physical security systems, coordinating with City agencies, leading staff training and exercises, supporting capital and facility safety improvements, and maintaining long term governance, documentation, and compliance for SFPL’s emergency preparedness and security framework.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Emergency Planning

Reviews and updates systemwide emergency plans (EOP, COOP) and standardizes key procedures such as evacuation, shelter‑in‑place, and lockdown.
Conducts security risk assessments across all facilities; develops systemwide security standards; and recommends risk mitigation strategies.
Develops communication tools and coordinates preparedness efforts with DEM, SFPD, SFFD, Public Works, and DT.
Establishes and maintains an SFPL‑specific ICS structure and coordinates Library roles during City EOC activations.

Security Management

Conducts security risk assessments across all facilities and recommends mitigation strategies.
Evaluates badge access, CCTV, alarms, and other security systems to guide upgrades and support capital planning. Develops long‑term security technology strategies and supports capital planning for facility safety improvements.

Training & Exercises

Provides emergency preparedness, safety, and de‑escalation training for staff.
Leads systemwide exercises, drills, and readiness assessments.
Leads after-action reviews following significant incidents and exercises and ensures lessons learned are incorporated into plans, procedures, training, and facility improvements.
Designs and implements ongoing emergency preparedness training programs and annual exercise schedules.

Governance & Compliance

Oversees incident reporting, security standards, and compliance with City regulations.
Maintains governance documentation and contributes to the Health & Safety Committee to ensure ongoing emergency readiness.
Supports integration of emergency planning and security standards into SFPL’s budget and capital planning processes.

How to qualify

Education:
Possession of a baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university AND

Experience:
4 years of professional experience in the applicable, major functional any of the following or combination of public safety, law or code enforcement, military, security, emergency operations, emergency planning.

Education Substitution:
Additional years of required experience may be substituted for the required degree on a year-for- year basis.

One year of full-time employment is equivalent to 2080 hours. (2080 hours of qualifying work experience is based on a 40-hour work week.) Any overtime hours that you work above forty (40) hours per week are not included in the calculation to determine full-time employment.

License and Certification:
Successful completion of National Incident Management System (NIMS) training compliant Incident Command System (ICS) training course 100, 200, 300, 400, 700, 800 or their recognized NIMS compliant equivalents within six months of employment.

Possession of a valid California driver’s license (to be presented at time of appointment)

Desirable Qualifications

2 years of Supervisory and Stakeholder Leadership - Demonstrated experience in supervising professional personnel and effectively managing diverse stakeholder relationships to ensure organizational alignment and accountability.
Experience in applying Incident Command System (ICS) frameworks in emergencies.
Experience collaborating with municipal public safety agencies on joint emergency planning initiatives and interagency coordination.
Experience in updating or developing systemwide emergency plans, including Emergency Operations Plans (EOP) and Continuity of Operations Plans (COOP).
Executive Customer Service - A track record of delivering exceptional customer service to varied stakeholders across all internal operations and external entities, including regulatory bodies and community organizations.
Public Communication and Reporting - Proven ability to prepare comprehensive written reports and deliver clear oral presentations regarding complex findings and strategic recommendations before public hearings and governing bodies.
Collaborative Relationship Management - Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team environment while establishing and maintaining cooperative partnerships with government agencies, community groups, special interest advocates, and members of the general public.
Executive Leadership and Strategic Influence - A proven record of functioning as an impactful leader among executive peers, driving continuous improvement and strategic initiatives across the organization.

Every application is reviewed to ensure that you meet the minimum qualifications listed in the job ad. Please review our articles on Employment Application and Minimum Qualifications and Verification of Experience and/or Education for considerations taken when reviewing applications.

Applicants may be required to submit verification of qualifying education and experience at any point during the recruitment and selection process.

new_jobs.description:
WHAT IS BOX?

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

WHY BOX NEEDS YOU

Box is expanding into a new era of monetization, one that blends our trusted subscription model with dynamic, consumption-based pricing for AI-powered and Platform capabilities. As the Program Manager, Consumption Products, you will own the day-to-day operations of this early-stage but high-priority business, sitting at the intersection of product, finance, analytics, and our customer-facing teams. This is a rare opportunity to build something new at scale: you will help define how Box monetizes AI Units today and lay the operational foundation for expanding consumption-based models across our Platform and beyond.

This role reports to the VP, Renewals and Consumption and carries direct visibility with Box's Chief Operating Officer and other senior leaders. You will work across an exceptionally diverse set of teams - from Product Management and Data Engineering to Billing, Marketing, and Account Teams serving as the connective tissue that keeps this fast-moving program running accurately and efficiently.

What You'll Do

You will own the customer-facing consumption program at Box globally. As the owner, you will:

Monitor daily customer consumption, overage trends, and program activity, identifying accounts that require action and driving unresolved issues to closure.
Coordinate and execute operational actions including exception handling, managing customer controls, advising on account-specific treatments, and providing validated data for periodic customer reporting and billing.
Serve as the first-line subject matter expert for consumption billing questions from Account Teams and GTM stakeholders, providing timely guidance on program mechanics, alerts, and commercial considerations.
Work with Business Analytics and Product teams to investigate new usage patterns and new reporting capabilities, translating business requirements into clear, actionable requests for analysts and data specialists.
Review product updates and policy changes to assess operational impact, and contribute to internal playbooks, FAQs, and customer-facing guidance.
Act as the cross-functional orchestrator across work-streams converting ambiguous problems into clear decisions, owners, and action plans — while maintaining an integrated view of dependencies across product, billing, analytics, marketing, and customer communications.
Lead the expansion of consumption billing to new products at Box

Who You Are

You love building from scratch and leaving your mark. You are someone who excitedly brings structure to chaos, with the ability to connect disparate dots and discern signal from noise. You are incredibly detail oriented with a “GSD” mindset, while always keeping the big picture in mind. Where others see problems, you see solutions. You always put the customer in the center of your decision making. If this sounds like you, you also likely have the following experience:

You have 4+ years of experience in management consulting, program management, operations, or a cross-functional business role, ideally within a consulting firm, SaaS or technology company.
You have a strong understanding of SaaS business models and familiarity with consumption-based or usage-based pricing, including AI-driven products.
You have clearly demonstrated quantitative analysis experience, comfortably bring able to perform moderate analyses’ and interpreting data prepared by others
You communicate clearly and concisely in both written and verbal form, with the ability to simplify complex policies, workflows, and commercial terms for diverse audiences.
You have strong attention to detail when handling customer-specific terms, exceptions, alerts, and operational actions.

Box lives its values, with community and in-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week. Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.

At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in. If you are head-over-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, and any other protected ground of discrimination under applicable human rights legislation. Box strives to respect the dignity and ‎‎independence of people with disabilities and is committed to giving them the same ‎‎opportunity to succeed as all other employees. Inclusiveness is core to our culture at Box, and we strive to ensure you get the most from your interview experience.

Box makes reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please complete this form. Reasonable accommodations may include scheduling adjustments, document dictation and beyond.

Experience managing large-scale cross-functional programs involving integrations, data migration, testing, governance, and production deployments.
Demonstrated success managing project budgets, schedules, resources, vendor relationships, and executive stakeholders.
Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working with Trading, Risk, Operations, Finance, and Technology teams in highly regulated or complex business environments.

Experience with multiple full lifecycle ETRM implementations.

Industry certifications related to ETRM platforms.

ETRM platforms such as:
Orchestrade

Allegro

Similar enterprise trading and risk management platforms
Project management methodologies and governance frameworks

Testing and UAT management tools
Enterprise reporting and dashboard solutions

new_jobs.description:
At Horizontal Digital, we hold ourselves to one key belief: You’re only as good as your worst customer experience. This mantra is what drives our digital consultancy to think beyond the easy answers and instead create websites, apps, portals and other experiences that solve customer needs for Fortune 500 companies in intuitive and empathetic ways. And we make this lofty standard a reality by fusing strategy, data, design and technology together to arrive at solutions that set the bar higher for everyone.

We use these values to fuel superior results:

Lock arms

We forge relationships that make our impact 1,000x stronger. This means working across departments and engaging both our clients and our communities to deliver the greatest good.
Show hustle

We’re not ones to sit on our hands and wait. Instead, we anticipate opportunities, collectively roll up our sleeves and find ways to execute the exceptional.
Embrace change

From new technologies to workplace philosophies, we welcome the unexpected and constantly anticipate what’s next.
Elevate empathy

We listen before we take action. This means understanding a variety of perspectives and holding ourselves to a higher standard of accountability.
Never settle

We motivate each other to push past the easy answers and collectively arrive at bigger, more inspiring ideas.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Project Manager with a consulting mindset to join our growing team.
In this role, you will be responsible for cultivating high-performing teams and acting as a trusted advisor to our clients. You will drive delivery excellence and value outcomes with speed and quality on your programs/projects. You will bring your expertise to partner with clients, identify their needs and challenges, and then leverage Agile (and hybrid) practices to deliver exceptional results.

What you’ll do:

Project Delivery:
Independently lead one large, complex project in a full-time capacity or multiple mid-size complex projects simultaneously comprised of cross-functional Horizontal team members.
Delivery Consulting:
Consult on delivery strategies to ensure success, including frameworks, tools, processes, etc. Drive agile and product delivery methods wherever possible. Solve complex delivery issues and modify processes as needed for each engagement to ensure success.
Project Planning:
Create and manage detailed project plans based on the delivery methodology/framework chosen, project scope, constraints, risks, and dependencies.
Budget Management:
Proactively manage your project budgets to ensure the work we’re planning to deliver can be accomplished within the approved budget. Monitor weekly burn and velocity to develop burndown reports against remaining scope. Understand and report on project margin performance and revenue forecasting. Develop plans to course-correct if project begins to trend over budget.
Risk Management:
Proactively identify project risks and build mitigation plans in an ongoing RAID log. Triage projects in the red to identify a path to green. Escalate as needed to obtain support and solve risks before they become issues.
Client Partnership:
Be the primary point of contact for clients in delivery to not only deliver consistent status, communicate risks, and manage deliverables – but also to build strong client relationships and be seen as a delivery leader and consultant.
Scope Management:
Fully understand the scope of work being delivered and consult with the team and client to manage to it consistently. Proactively prioritize scope where needed. Estimate, create, and deliver change orders as needed when scope deviates.
Tools Knowledge:
Hold expert-level knowledge of standard PM tools, including Smartsheet and Atlassian suite (Jira; Confluence).
Team Leadership:
Lead a team of globally distributed cross-functional Horizontal designers, strategists, technologists, etc. to understand client objectives and successfully deliver solutions that achieve them. Manage resourcing process within assigned projects.
Practice Involvement:
Actively participate in initiatives that uplevel and mature the Horizontal Delivery team. Proactively identify ways we can improve our processes/methods and work with practice leadership to fill gaps as appropriate.
Mentorship and Coaching:
Mentor junior program managers and team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and development.

Who you are:

Digital Consulting Experience

Proven track record of leading and executing large-scale digital transformation initiatives that deliver significant business value and competitive advantage.
Deep expertise in leveraging key technologies like CMS, CRM, CDP, Sitecore, and Salesforce products to drive transformational digital initiatives.
Experience in advising key client stakeholders on digital program best practices to optimize their program operations and enhance their digital presence.
Ability to identify and capitalize on new opportunities to drive growth and innovation.

Project Management Expertise

Proven ability to lead and manage multiple complex digital projects simultaneously, ensuring successful delivery of value with quality and speed to meet business objectives within budget and exceeding client expectations.
Proven ability to align digital initiatives with overall business goals and drive measurable outcomes.
Deep experience in managing large, geographically dispersed teams to foster collaboration and deliver results.
Proven ability to define contracts and manage programs and partnership to contract terms that will achieve and drive business value.
Proactive approach to risk management and issue resolution, ensuring project success.
Strong financial acumen to estimate and optimize project profitability.
Proficiency with advanced project management methodologies and tools, including Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid approaches.
Analytical and problem-solving skills to anticipate and address complex challenges proactively

Team Leadership and Development

Proven ability to build and lead high-performing teams of digital experts, fostering a culture of innovation and excellence.
Strong leadership skills to inspire and motivate teams to achieve ambitious goals.
Mentorship and coaching skills to develop and empower team members to reach their full potential.
Effective conflict resolution skills to maintain a positive and productive team environment.

Effective Communication and Presentation

Exceptional interpersonal skills to build strong relationships with clients and stakeholders at all levels.
Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences clearly and concisely.
Influence and persuasion skills to drive consensus and gain buy-in from key stakeholders.
Strong communication skills to present strategic recommendations and justify investment decisions.

What you bring:

Minimum 7+ years of experience leading digital projects/programs.
A minimum of 2 years agency/consultancy experience. 5+ years preferred.
Bachelor’s degree preferred.
Certifications in Agile methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master (CSM), PMI-ACP) preferred.
Experience with standard project management tools including Smartsheet and Jira/Confluence (or similar).

Position Description

The Project Manager leads large-scale technology projects at Applied Medical, managing software applications, systems, platforms, services, and infrastructure initiatives throughout the full project lifecycle from initialization through deployment. This role oversees high-priority and business-critical projects that span information technology and infrastructure domains, often involving global team members and timelines ranging from one to five years in duration. The Project Manager defines project scope, coordinates deliverable schedules across cross-functional teams, and develops risk mitigation strategies while facilitating technically sound solutions aligned with Applied Medical's organizational objectives. Professionals with backgrounds in IT project management, enterprise systems implementation, infrastructure program management, or technology delivery will find this role a strong fit.

Key Responsibilities

Manage all stages of the project lifecycle for large-scale technology and infrastructure projects, including scope definition, scheduling, risk management, issue resolution, and budget oversight using established project management methodologies.
Prepare comprehensive project plans for all phases of the project lifecycle, balancing resource allocation across teams to ensure milestones and delivery timelines are consistently met.
Proactively identify and manage changes in project scope, issues, and risks, developing and executing contingency plans to keep high-priority initiatives on track.
Develop and prioritize project deliverables and artifacts, maintaining accurate meeting minutes that document key decisions and action items throughout the project lifecycle.
Facilitate project communication and change management activities, ensuring stakeholders at all levels receive clear, timely, and accurate updates on project status and progress.
Collaborate with business analysts, internal customers, and cross-functional teams to gather project requirements and ensure technical solutions align with business needs.
Manage vendor relationships and facilitate vendor evaluations in support of technology procurement and implementation activities.
Track and report project progress, risks, and financial performance to stakeholders, preparing and maintaining project documentation and reports within established timeframes.
Mentor and provide guidance to Project Coordinators and Project Analysts where applicable, supporting the development of junior team members within the project management function.
Apply a high level of attention to detail across all assigned projects, maintaining rigor and discipline throughout engagements that span multiple years and involve significant organizational complexity.

Success in This Role Looks Like

Delivering large-scale technology and infrastructure projects on time, within scope, and within budget, with clear documentation and consistent stakeholder alignment throughout.
Anticipating project risks and scope changes early, presenting well-reasoned mitigation strategies to leadership before issues affect delivery timelines or outcomes.
Building trusted working relationships with cross-functional teams, business analysts, and vendor partners that support effective collaboration across complex, multi-year engagements.
Producing project documentation, financial tracking reports, and status updates that give leadership accurate and timely visibility into project health across the portfolio.
Demonstrating sound judgment in planning and organizing projects of high complexity, maintaining discipline and follow-through across all phases of the project lifecycle.
Contributing to the growth of the project management function by mentoring junior team members and modeling best practices in project governance and delivery.

Position Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, business administration, or a related field.

Advanced experience managing application development projects and cross-functional technical initiatives.
Proficiency in project management methodologies, tools, and software, including scheduling, tracking, and reporting systems.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical information to diverse audiences.

Preferred

Experience managing software and application development projects within a manufacturing or production environment.
Familiarity with Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodologies, Agile frameworks, and enterprise system integrations.
Certification in project management such as Project Management Professional (PMP) or Certified ScrumMaster (CSM).
Experience collaborating with global teams on large-scale, multi-year projects.
