new_jobs.description:
About Apply

APPLY is the Agentic Customer Experience (ACx) partner for the world's most ambitious consumer and entertainment brands. We bring together deep domain expertise across Retail, CPG, Sports, and Media with AI-native delivery capability, designing and delivering agentic solutions that turn CX vision into commercial reality. We are the partner of choice for brands like Arc'teryx, NFL, Lululemon, and Kraft Heinz. For more information, visit applydigital.com .

LOCATION:
APPLY is hybrid/remote-friendly. The preferred candidate should be based in Latin America
, preferably working in hours that align to PT (Pacific Timezone) or
ET (Eastern Timezone)
. Candidates located in Santiago, Chile are able to work out of our Santiago office as remote/hybrid employees. Candidates located outside of Santiago, Chile will be fully remote employees.

THE ROLE:

As a Senior Project Manager, you are a champion for Project Management and Agile best-practices but are flexible, and can adjust your processes to fit your project team and clients’ needs. You are comfortable wearing multiple hats and acting as a Scrum Master. You can manage budgets, timelines and client expectations with ease. You are a consultant, a problem solver, and a “big picture” thinker while digging into the details. The ideal candidate will be solution-driven and able to handle multiple fast-paced projects while managing multiple teams and communicating with leadership. Above all , you are accountable to your team, to yourself, and to the delivery of excellence.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Own capacity and resource allocation tracking across Managed Services squads, maintaining an accurate and up-to-date view of team availability, utilisation, and workload balance and forward-looking capacity forecasts to anticipate demand across the client portfolio..
Monitor hours consumption against retainer allocations on a regular cadence, surfacing discrepancies, overruns, or underutilisation early and escalating as appropriate.
Proactively identify and flag delivery risks — timeline slippage, team bottlenecks, scope creep, dependency blockers — before they escalate, and coordinate resolution/mitigation plan with squad leads and tech leads.
Manage squad-level delivery processes: maintain backlogs, track sprint progress, coordinate ceremonies (planning, retrospectives, demos), and ensure delivery cadences are followed consistently.
Partner with the London-based Senior PM to ensure seamless handoff and alignment between client-facing commitments and internal execution capacity.
Support the Director of Managed Services with operational reporting, including utilisation metrics, team health signals, and portfolio-level status updates.
Maintain documentation hygiene across tools (Jira, Notion, Tempo, etc.), ensuring project data is reliable and accessible for the wider team.
Contribute to the ongoing improvement of MgS operational processes, templates, and tooling as the practice scales.
Coordinate onboarding logistics for new clients or new squad members, ensuring teams have what they need to start well.

REQUIREMENTS:

4–6+ years of experience in project management, delivery management, or operations roles within a digital agency, consultancy, or software delivery environment.
Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams or client accounts with strong attention to detail and organisational discipline.
Hands-on experience with resource or capacity management — tracking team utilisation, managing allocations, and producing operational reports.
Solid understanding of Agile delivery methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and experience running or supporting sprint ceremonies.
Proficiency with project management and delivery tooling, particularly Jira, Confluence, and Notion. Experience with time-tracking tools (e.g. Tempo) is a strong asset.
Comfortable working with data: able to read hours reports, identify trends, and present clear summaries to stakeholders without requiring heavy data analysis support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; ability to communicate clearly across time zones in async-first environments.
Experience working with or within a managed services, retainer-based, or continuous delivery model is a strong advantage.
Thrives in a support-oriented role and measures success through team outcomes rather than individual recognition.
A proactive, ownership-driven mindset: you flag problems before they become crises, and you follow through.

LIFE AT APPLY

People are at the core of everything we do at APPLY. We provide you with modern tools, systems and approaches, value your time, safety, and health, and strive to build a work community where you can thrive and grow. Here are a few benefits we offer to support you:

Agentic Delivery:
Our people work in a modern way to deliver client outcomes. Broaden your skills on a range of engagements with international brands that have a global impact.

An inclusive and safe environment:
We’re truly committed to building a culture where you are celebrated and everyone feels welcome and safe.

AI & Strategic Upskilling:
Accelerate your professional growth with generous training budgets and mentorship, with a specific focus on Agentic AI expertise and the critical human skills required for the future of work.

Generous vacation policy:
Work-life balance is key to our team’s success, so we offer ample time away from work to promote overall well-being.

Flexible work arrangements:
We work in a variety of ways, from remote, to in-office, to a blend of both.

new_jobs.description:
About the company

Our client is a cash flow positive AI venture studio that combines strategy, product development, and long term value creation. The team works inside PE backed and mid market companies to redesign workflows around AI, then builds and helps adopt the products those businesses need. The studio has about 40 to 45 people and is growing as new ventures and transformation programs begin.
The role

We are hiring a Product Strategist to lead the discovery and workflow analysis behind new venture builds. You will interview stakeholders, map how work and value move through a business, sequence the highest impact use cases, and turn those findings into product specifications that engineers can build against. You will stay involved through evaluation, adoption, and the decisions that shape each product.
What you'll do

Lead stakeholder and operator interviews and turn unstructured input into clear findings.
Map workflows at the task level and identify where the largest value pools sit.
Sequence AI use cases by value, feasibility, and data readiness, then defend the ordering.
Write priority questions, acceptance criteria, data contracts, and clean product specifications.
Help define golden datasets, evaluation datasets, success measures, and time to answer benchmarks.
Run demos, pre reads, follow ups, training, and feedback loops that drive real adoption.
Maintain concise decision records so product choices stay traceable after each meeting.

What we're looking for

One of two relevant profiles: 3 to 7 years across top strategy consulting, private equity, or venture capital plus hands on startup, product, or operator experience; or 7 to 12 years at a top strategy, private equity, or venture capital firm with principal or partner level responsibility.
Demonstrated product judgment and the ability to translate business needs into buildable requirements.
Hands on use of AI tools, coding, GitHub projects, or side builds, rather than theoretical familiarity alone.
Strong business acumen and experience working with senior executives and technical teams.
A bachelor's degree from a top tier university.
A coherent career narrative with clear ownership, measurable impact, and no pattern of unexplained short stays.

Bonus points

Technical fluency in Python, data analysis, AI feasibility, or system design.
Experience building or deploying products inside a startup or technology company.
Experience with venture building, business transformation, or value creation for PE backed companies.

Compensation and benefits

Base salary of $185K-$250K, based on experience and qualifications.
Uncapped consulting bonus potential.
Competitive platform equity and studio equity in ventures launched by the team.
Participation in fund carry.

Hybrid, with three days per week in the Flatiron District of Manhattan or Chicago.
Full time position.

Founded in 1966, Niterra North America, Inc. (formerly NGK Spark Plugs) is the world leader in technology, innovation, and world-class quality in the design of spark plugs and oxygen sensors. Today, that tradition continues as we transform our organization's portfolio, expand our core ceramic technologies, explore capabilities beyond traditional areas, and challenge ourselves to develop solutions and services that leverage technology to address social issues while contributing to a sustainable society.

Summary:

The BI Manager is responsible for leading the Business Intelligence team and serving as a strategic business partner to Sales and cross-functional teams through category, customer, market, and performance analysis. Based in Wixom, Michigan, this role integrates complex data sources to generate actionable insights, supports strategic planning and sales forecasting, and develops BI and reporting tools that drive sales, profitability, and category growth. The ideal candidate brings strong leadership and people-management skills, advanced analytical capabilities, and deep Category Management expertise.

Classification:
Salary, Exempt

Work Model:
Hybrid

Responsibilities:

Supervise and lead Business Intelligence (BI) team members by providing coaching, mentorship, guidance, and performance support to build a high-performing and analytically strong team.

Lead and support CBO Business Unit and key account strategic planning processes by integrating internal and external data, identifying key business and customer issues and opportunities, and developing actionable recommendations to inform strategic decisions.

Serve as a strategic business partner to Sales and cross-functional teams by providing category, customer, market, competitive, and performance analysis to support effective business strategies and tactics.

Proactively identify business needs, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement, and lead ad hoc analytical and strategic projects to ensure timely, high-quality completion.

Collaborate with customers and internal teams to evaluate product lines, optimize product assortment and shelf merchandising, and develop pricing and promotional recommendations that drive sales, profitability, and category growth.

Conduct ongoing analysis of market, customer, competitive, and industry dynamics, including macroeconomic and automotive industry developments, to identify emerging trends, risks, and growth opportunities.

Monitor and validate market share performance and historical trends to identify opportunities for existing and prospective products, providing actionable recommendations to Sales, Product, Marketing, and Executive leadership.

Develop and maintain standardized and ad hoc reporting solutions using internal and external data sources, efficiently managing large, complex datasets to deliver accurate, concise, and actionable reports and presentations within established timelines.

Develop and enhance customized BI and reporting tools that enable Sales teams to effectively communicate sales performance, market trends, category insights, and business opportunities to customers.

Identify and implement technology, analytics platforms, and process improvements, including Power BI and Looker, to enhance data capabilities, reporting efficiency, and team technical skills.

Communicate business performance, market intelligence, analytical findings, and strategic recommendations to Sales, BI, Executive leadership, and Niterra Global Headquarters through regularly scheduled business reviews and quarterly updates.

Lead and coordinate BI activities supporting CBO sales forecasting processes to ensure accurate, consistent, and timely forecasts that meet annual GHQ requirements.

Manage the annual BI department budget within a zero-based budgeting environment and coordinate the CBO annual budget summary process to support effective planning, resource allocation, and cost management.

Support and validate customer pricing activities, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and compliance with individual customer data-load requirements.

Partner with Supply Chain and related functions to leverage data and analytics in support of production, inventory, warehousing, demand, and order planning to effectively meet customer requirements.

Perform all other job-related tasks as assigned.

Adhere to all company policies and procedures as applicable.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, or a related field.

3+ years of experience in a supervisory or people-management role.

Strong leadership, people-management, coaching, and team-development skills.

Demonstrated ability to integrate and analyze multiple complex data sources to generate actionable insights and develop clear, data-driven action plans.

Advanced analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to synthesize and interpret information from multiple sources and identify relationships among data, trends, business drivers, and market events.

Strong understanding of Category Management principles, including assortment planning, sales and profitability analysis, pricing, merchandising, and category performance optimization.

Proven experience developing, managing, and executing projects, with strong project planning, prioritization, and organizational skills.

Experience with Category Management and business intelligence tools, such as JDA/ProSpace and Microsoft Power BI.

Excellent verbal, written, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear business recommendations for diverse audiences.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Experience with Google Workspace and data visualization/analytics platforms such as Looker.

Strong organizational, problem-solving, collaboration, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively partner across functions and influence business decisions.

Country:

Location:

Data Analyst

Be at the forefront of transforming British Army training.

About us:

At OMNIA® Training, we’ve brought together some of the UK’s most innovative defence training organisations under one powerful mission: to transform the British Army’s training system and create the best-trained Army in the world.

OMNIA are redefining the British Army’s collective training. To do that, we are looking for the best and brightest minds from across the UK. We are backed by British innovation and powered by world-class experts, like you. OMNIA is at the heart of the UK’s bold Land Industrial Strategy.

The role:

This is more than a job — it’s a mission. You will be part of a high-impact, collaborative environment, where we expect everyone to live the values and standards of the British Army. Every person in our team plays a critical role in delivering OMNIA’s vision; designing, delivering, and transforming collective training so the British Army is ready to fight and win.

You’ll work in a matrix organisation and report operationally through OMNIA Training and functionally through the OMNIA Enterprise Architect. Ultimately, you’ll work for the British Army, championing innovation, and helping shape the future of military collective training.

Key Responsibilities:

Analyse complex datasets and translate findings into actionable insights aligned with Army training objectives.

Design and deliver clear, meaningful visualisations and reports that support operational decision-making.

Explore and analyse through use of statistical tools and techniques data to identify patterns, relationships and trends to inform further development.

Collaborate with data architects and engineers to ensure analytical outputs align with enterprise architecture and platform standards.

Support the evolution of data architectures by contributing analytical requirements and feedback.

Communicate analytical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders to inform strategy and operational improvements.

Conduct exploratory analysis and limited prototyping to evaluate emerging data techniques relevant to training analytics.

Ensure analytics processes comply with security, governance, and regulatory requirements.

Author and maintain documentation to ensure analytical processes are repeatable, auditable, and scalable.

Any other duties required to meet the needs of the programme.

Who we are looking for:

You’ll have a mission focus, and the enthusiasm and drive to ‘get things done’. You’ll want to work in collaboration with other defence training organisations, and the British Army. You won’t let bureaucracy get in the way of what needs to be done, you’ll learn lessons and share these lessons across the team. You’ll understand what it means to put the mission first.

We’re looking for a curious, detail-oriented Data Analyst who thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment. The ideal candidate will be passionate about unlocking the value of data to improve Army training outcomes, with a strong ability to interpret complex datasets and communicate insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. They should be comfortable working across hybrid cloud environments, collaborating with engineers and architects, and contributing to the evolution of innovative, secure, and scalable data solutions. A proactive mindset, eagerness to explore emerging technologies, and commitment to data integrity and governance are essential. This role requires a systems-thinking mindset, strong stakeholder engagement skills, and the ability to work across engineering teams in a complex and evolving environment.

Essential Skills and Experience:

Minimum 2+ years’ experience in a Data Analyst or similar analytical role, ideally within defence, government, or complex enterprise environments.

Experience working within large-scale, secure data environments and contributing to digital transformation initiatives.

Working knowledge of data architecture principles and experience collaborating with engineering teams in Agile delivery environments.

Understanding of relational and dimensional data modelling, including support for metadata and data dictionary management.

Understanding of data security principles, governance frameworks, and MOD compliance standards.

Strong SQL skills for querying and manipulating structured datasets.

Proficiency in Python or R for statistical analysis, data wrangling, and automation.

Experience building dashboards and visualisations using Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent BI tools.

Advanced Excel skills for analytical modelling and reporting.

Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure or AWS), particularly in hybrid data environments.

Experience working with data Lakehouse technologies (e.g. Delta Lake, Databricks, or similar platforms).

Be able to travel to programme and customer meetings across the UK as required.

Security cleared or ability to obtain (SC or above).

Desirable Skills and Experience:

Degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or related discipline (MSc desirable but not essential), or equivalent professional accreditation.

Experience working within cross-functional teams including architects, engineers, and programme leads.

Experience with additional BI and analytics platforms (e.g. Looker, Elastic Stack, or similar visualisation and observability tools).

Knowledge of data protection and compliance frameworks (e.g. UK GDPR, Data Protection Act, or comparable regulatory standards).

Relevant professional certifications (e.g. Microsoft Certified Data Analyst Associate, AWS/Azure Data Fundamentals, DAMA Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP), or equivalent).

Familiarity with training systems, simulation data, or performance analytics.

What we offer:

Be Part of a Ground-breaking Mission

Join the UK’s most advanced defence training alliance, where industry experts converge to push boundaries and deliver excellence.

A Culture Built on Collaboration

Work in an inclusive, high-performing team that celebrates ideas, supports growth, and is laser-focused on delivering results.

Team dynamics

You will be part of a team that works together, across multiple organisations united in one mission.

Work Across Borders, United in Purpose

Operate across organisations with one shared goal - improving capability across all domains.

Drive Innovation

Your voice matters. We champion new ideas, welcome change, and believe in continuous improvement with a growth mind-set.

Shape the Future

Play a crucial role in a long-term, future-facing programme with real-world impact on national defence.

Career Growth & Benefits

Enjoy a strong benefits package, ongoing development opportunities, and clear pathways to progress within a trusted defence industry partner.

OMNIA® Training and its partners are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities — what matters is your passion, your expertise, and your dedication to the mission.

Why Join Q2?

Q2 is a leading provider of digital banking and lending solutions to banks, credit unions, alternative finance companies, and fintechs in the U.S. and internationally. Our mission is simple: build strong and diverse communities through innovative financial technology—and we do that by empowering our people to help create success for our customers.

What Makes Q2 Special?

Being as passionate about our people as we are about our mission. We celebrate our employees in many ways through our year-round Q2 ChangeMakers awards program and global moments of recognition and connection. We invest in the growth and development of our team members through ongoing learning opportunities, internal mobility, and meaningful leadership relationships. We also know that nothing builds trust and collaboration like having fun and giving back together. From company-wide volunteer days to events like our Q2 Homecoming Week—featuring learning, community service, and culture-building experiences—we create opportunities to connect, grow, and make an impact.

Our Team

The Fraud Intelligence team at Q2 is responsible for helping our customers take a proactive stance against fraud and managing the risks of their business. We build and enhance products that evolve with the ever-changing fraud landscape, delivering tangible value for our customers. Our solutions enable them to focus more of their time and energy on their mission: best serving their customers and communities.

The Role

As a Data Analyst on the team, you will develop a deep understanding of our customers and the fraud challenges they face. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and Fraud Response partners, you will identify and help close gaps in our fraud products. This is a dynamic role, sitting at the cross-section of our customers, the business, and product development. You’ll be responsible for tracking trends in our fraud cases and advising prioritization in product enhancements. Then, you’ll take the next step and work with our internal tooling and engineering teams to build the needed protection for our customers.

You are more likely to excel in the role if you:

Enjoy autonomy in your work and feel a sense of ownership in the team’s goals. You work quickly but with the big picture in mind.
Have empathy for end users and a desire to measure your work by both the customer value and product quality.
Have enthusiasm for the field and professional development.

Requirements

5+ years of experience as an analyst (or similar)
Experience using AI tools in your work
Statistical background and ability to draw sound conclusions from complex data
Familiarity with data visualization tools
Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate findings with technical and non-technical audiences

Experience with python, SQL, or other programming languages
Experience communicating with customers
Familiarity with the financial industry, banking, and fraud prevention products

Day in Life:

This role is a corporate Customer Experience position responsible for helping Hertz build a more modern, data-driven, and action-oriented understanding of the customer experience. The Sr. Analyst will analyze customer feedback, operational performance, transaction data, and customer behavior to identify where the experience is working, where it breaks down, and what actions can improve customer and business outcomes.
The ideal candidate is a strong analyst who is curious, AI-forward, comfortable working with messy data, and able to connect structured and unstructured customer signals with business data to develop clear insights, recommendations, and measurable impact.
In practice, this may include analyzing customer experience performance, reviewing survey verbatims and service interactions, connecting feedback to operational or transactional data, using SQL and modern data tools to investigate root causes, leveraging AI tools to accelerate analysis and synthesis, building repeatable reporting views, and preparing clear recommendations that help cross-functional teams improve the customer experience.
This position starts at $100K commensurate of experience.

What You’ll Do:

Analyze customer feedback, operational data, transaction data, and customer behavior to identify patterns, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
Synthesize structured and unstructured feedback from surveys, service interactions, reviews, and other listening sources.
Develop clear measurement approaches, KPIs, and analytical frameworks to quantify customer experience performance and business impact.
Translate complex data and customer signals into concise insights, recommendations, and next steps business partners can act on.
Clearly communicate what is known, what is still a hypothesis, where data limitations exist, and what actions should follow.
Partner cross-functionally to connect insights to practical actions, accountable owners, and measurable outcomes.
Use SQL, modern data platforms, data visualization tools, and AI-enabled workflows to improve speed, quality, scalability, and repeatability of analysis.
Build dashboards, reporting views, analytical tools, and reusable data assets that help leaders monitor performance and identify where and when action is needed.
Leverage AI tools to support customer comment analysis, data exploration, coding assistance, analytical QA, insight development, and workflow automation.
Operate with ownership, urgency, and collaboration while helping the team move from reporting activity to measurable customer and business improvement.
Bring structure, curiosity, accuracy, and sound judgment to ambiguous customer and business problems.
Document metric definitions, assumptions, data limitations, and QA checks to ensure insights are trustworthy and repeatable.

What We’re Looking For:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.
3 years of experience in analytics, customer insights, operations analytics, product analytics, commercial analytics, consulting, or a similar quantitative/business field required.
Strong SQL skills required.
Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Databricks dashboards, or similar data visualization tools.
Strong analytical judgment with the ability to move from data to insight to recommendation.
Experience working with large, complex, and often messy datasets.
Experience analyzing customer feedback, survey verbatims, contact center data, reviews, or other unstructured feedback at scales preferred.
AI-forward mindset with demonstrated curiosity and willingness to use modern AI-enabled tools to improve analytical speed, quality, synthesis, and repeatability.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create concise executive-ready summaries.
High attention to detail and strong commitment to data accuracy, QA, and reporting governance.
Flexible and adaptable; able to work effectively in ambiguous situations.
Results-driven, curious, and comfortable challenging assumptions.
Ability to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders across multiple functions and locations.
Preferred experience in travel, hospitality, mobility, retail, logistics, customer operations, or service-intensive industries.

Job Description Summary

The Endpoint Security Analyst is responsible for implementing, maintaining, and optimizing endpoint security technologies across the enterprise. This role serves as an escalation resource for complex endpoint security incidents while ensuring endpoint platforms remain secure, compliant, and resilient. The analyst will work closely with infrastructure, cybersecurity, and application teams to protect enterprise devices, improve security posture, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

Job Description

Responsibilities

Implement, maintain, and optimize endpoint security controls across client and server environments, ensuring alignment with security frameworks and enterprise standards.
Serve as a third-line escalation point for complex endpoint security incidents impacting device security, compliance, or user productivity.
Monitor endpoint telemetry, security agent health, performance indicators, and compliance metrics to proactively identify risks and operational issues.
Conduct endpoint testing to evaluate endpoint impact, validate security controls, and identify vulnerabilities.
Diagnose and resolve endpoint-related incidents and recurring security issues using structured troubleshooting methodologies.
Manage and maintain endpoint security technologies including policies, CASB, EDR, antivirus, data loss prevention (DLP), encryption solutions, compliance agents, and automated remediation tools.
Track security control health and coordinate remediation activities with cybersecurity teams when critical findings are identified.
Maintain endpoint management portals, dashboards, documentation, and knowledge repositories to support operational excellence.
Monitor, identify, and remediate endpoint software defects to ensure stable and secure application performance.
Install, test, and validate endpoint security agents, policies, and integrations in non-production environments before production deployment.
Review and approve access requests while enforcing least-privilege principles and organizational security standards.
Support audit, compliance, and governance initiatives by identifying risks, documenting findings, and assisting with remediation efforts.

Skills

Advanced knowledge of endpoint security technologies, including CASB, EDR, antivirus, DLP, encryption, compliance management, and endpoint protection platforms.
Strong understanding of endpoint security architecture, lifecycle management, and security best practices.
Experience analyzing security telemetry, behavioral indicators, and trend data to support proactive threat mitigation.
Strong troubleshooting skills across endpoint, application, and operating system layers.
Experience working with EDR, SIEM, MDM, compliance platforms, and enterprise security management tools.
Ability to correlate data from multiple sources to identify risks and recommend actionable remediation plans.
Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills.
Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cybersecurity, infrastructure, and application teams.
Experience creating reports, dashboards, metrics, and executive summaries related to security posture and endpoint health.
Commitment to continuous learning through certifications, training, and industry best practices.

Education

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Management Information Systems, or a related discipline, and five (5+) years of relevant experience in endpoint security, cybersecurity operations, systems administration, or a related technical field. Equivalent combinations of education, training, and experience totaling five or more years in an enterprise environment will be considered.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, Sky High, SentinelOne, Tanium, Ivanti, or comparable endpoint security platforms.
Security-related certifications such as Security+, CySA+, CISSP, GIAC, Microsoft Security Certifications, or equivalent.
Experience supporting enterprise-scale endpoint environments in highly regulated industries.

Education

Bachelor’s: Computer and Information Science, Bachelor’s: Information Technology

Work Experience

General Experience - 3 to 6 years

Certifications

Travel

Less than 25%

Workstyle

Hybrid

new_jobs.title: Cyber Security Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Cybersecurity Analyst - ABBADOX

Company Overview

At AbbaDox, we look for passionate and innovative talent to help us optimize practice operations. Named one of South Florida Sun Sentinel's Top Workplaces for 2026, AbbaDox is growing rapidly, and we are seeking motivated professionals to help us shape the future of healthcare IT.
Cybersecurity Analyst

Title: Cybersecurity Analyst
Location: Hallandale Beach, FL.
Report to: Chief Information Security Officer
Status: Full-Time
AbbaDox builds the software platform radiology centers run their patient workflows on. Protecting that platform is currently a one-person job , this role makes it two.
You will work directly with the CISO. That means real ownership from week one: you will triage the alerts, run the hunts, review the cloud configs, and help decide what gets fixed first. It also means no two days look the same. Some weeks are deep in detection logic and threat hunting. Some are spent tearing apart a cloud environment looking for what shouldn't be there. Some are incident response.
We are hiring for trajectory, not a checklist. If you have a couple of years of solid hands-on experience, an obsessive curiosity about how things break, and the discipline to teach yourself what you don't know yet, you'll do well here.
Responsibilities

●       Detection & Threat Hunting

○      Triage, investigate, and close out alerts across our XDR and endpoint protection stack — and improve
the detection logic behind the noisy ones.
○      Run proactive threat hunts rather than waiting for an alert to tell you something is wrong: build a
hypothesis, query the data, prove or disprove it, document what you found.
●       Identity & Endpoint Security

○      Monitor and harden our identity layer — SSO, MFA, conditional access, privileged accounts, and the
anomalies that show up in authentication logs.
○      Support endpoint security and device management: compliance policies, device posture, patch and
configuration drift across the fleet.
●       Cloud & Application Security

○      Review cloud environments against security best practices — IAM permissions, network exposure,
logging coverage, misconfigurations — and drive the findings to closure with engineering.
○      Participate in code and pull request reviews from a security perspective: authentication and
authorization logic, input handling, secrets management, dependency risk.
●       Incident Response & Documentation

○      Help investigate and contain security incidents, including phishing, compromised accounts, and
vendor-side events, and write up what happened.
○      Work alongside DevOps and engineering as a partner, not a gate — findings come with context and
a path to fixing them.
○      Build the documentation, runbooks, and reporting that make the security program repeatable.
Requirements

●      1–3 years of hands-on experience in security, IT, infrastructure, or a SOC role. Sysadmin, NOC,
helpdesk-to-security, and internship-plus-lab paths all count if you can demonstrate the skills.
●      Working familiarity with an EDR or XDR platform: you've triaged real alerts, understand what the
detection was actually looking for, and know the difference between noise and something worth
escalating.
●      Understanding of endpoint protection and antivirus — how it works, how it's evaded, and why
coverage gaps happen.
●      Exposure to an identity provider and the concepts behind it: single sign-on, MFA, conditional access,
least privilege.
●      Exposure to endpoint or mobile device management: enrollment, compliance policy, and device
posture enforcement.
●      Familiarity with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and its core security primitives
— identity and access management, network controls, and logging.
●      Enough comfort with code to follow application logic and spot obvious security problems. You do not
need to be a developer, but you should not be afraid of a pull request.
●      Genuinely self-directed. You research what you don't know, you ask sharp questions, and you don't
need a ticket assigned to you to find work worth doing.
●      Clear written communication. If you found something and can't explain it, it doesn't get fixed.
Preferred Skills

●      Experience across more than one cloud provider.
●      Scripting or automation ability in Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
●      Detection engineering experience, or comfort writing queries against a SIEM or log platform.
●      Home lab, CTF, bug bounty, or self-taught offensive security work — we would rather see what you've
built and broken than a list of courses.
●      Container, Kubernetes, or CI/CD pipeline exposure.
●      Certifications such as Security+, AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty, GCIH, or eJPT are welcome, but we
weight demonstrated skill higher.
How You'll Grow

This is a deliberately broad role, and the breadth is the point. Over your first 18 months you will get real depth in threat hunting and detection engineering, multi-cloud security, application security and secure code review, and incident response — the kind of range that is difficult to get on a large team where analysts stay in one lane. You will have a clear path toward a senior security engineering track.
AbbaDox Benefit Highlights

Health Insurance, 401(k), Vacation, Employee Assistance Program, Flexible Spending Accounts
Along with health and financial benefits, we provide our team with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an environment where all employees are valued.
AbbaDox is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity—that's why we recruit and hire applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other factor prohibited by law.

Organizational Studies and Budget Support

Plans and conducts studies for efficiency of operations of Bureau organizations ranging from single units to the Directorate level, including any overseas or otherwise geographically separated organizational entities by means of personal interviews, on-site observation, and study of documentation, notes work load, work flow, processes, methods, turnaround time on transactions, complicating factors beyond the immediate control of the organization studied, findings of prior Departmental or outside management audits, and feedback from client organizations in order to evaluate the organizational entity’s efficiency.

Designs and administers planning and controls for submission of data, including forming the basis of budget and program resource requests and decisions.

Policy Analysis, Management and Counsel

Manages a portfolio of MED/DMD/OM programs/projects, responsible for tracking workflow, work assignments, conflicts, and deadlines, and accepts responsibility for bringing matters to completion and achieving required results.
Develops central level management policy and procedures for MED/DMD/OM projects while developing plans based on broad strategic support requirements and condensing strategic objectives into operational concepts, standards, procedures, and executable tasks.
Identifies legal implications of applicable statutes, procurement authorities, international agreements, regulations, and Foreign Affairs Manual provisions that impact MED/DMD/OM programs/projects, explaining their effect on MED/DMD/OM programs/projects.
Performs fact-finding and research on a wide variety of topical issues necessary to complete special projects.
Formulates first draft responses to myriad senior level inquiries.

Manages assigned programs/projects from inception through completion.
Builds positive customer relations and creates new business processes, procedures, techniques, and systems that relate to the assigned program/project.
Develops novel approaches to overcome obstacles to MED/DMD/OM projects in support of expeditionary medicine activities, applying research skills and professional approaches to identify, analyze, and solve challenges.
Exercises initiative and creativity, recognizing and advising MED/DMD/OM personnel of areas of deficiency, potential problems, trends or similar factors of interest and develops innovative recommendations to strengthen identified issues.
Assists higher level staff in reviewing and evaluating bureau and intra-bureau policies, procedures, and existing guidelines that impact MED/DMD/OM projects.

Stratus® is an integrated, multi-disciplinary engineering, architecture, interior design, and consulting firm. Consistently ranking among the Top 500 Design Firms in Engineering News-Record, the firm offers a deep bench of industry experts through a highly collaborative approach, delivering innovative solutions across the full project lifecycle. The Role

We are seeking a Project Operations Analyst to provide hands-on support to project managers and business leaders across day-to-day operational and project delivery activities. This role is a critical resource for PMs navigating project setup, forecasting, and cost management, while also supporting leadership with financial analysis and performance reporting.

Responsibilities

Support project managers with project setup, cost tracking, forecasting, estimate at completion (EAC) analysis, and project reviews
Monitor project portfolio performance including margin variance, unbilled, and A/R, and partner with PMs to address issues proactively
Provide financial and operational analysis to division and market leadership to support decision-making and performance improvement
Prepare monthly financial reports, quarterly forecasts, and preliminary project budgets for assigned markets or business units
Assist with opportunity and pursuit tracking, project execution pricing models, and risk management activities
Serve as a day-to-day resource and advocate for project managers, providing guidance on company policies, procedures, and project delivery tools
Develop job aids, tracking tools, and templates that simplify project delivery workflows and improve PM compliance
Collaborate with finance and operations teams to ensure accurate and timely project data in ERP and reporting systems

Qualifications

Required

4-7 years of experience in project controls, operations coordination, or PMO support within AEC or professional services
Hands-on experience supporting PMs with project setup, cost management, and forecasting
Strong analytical and Excel skills; experience with financial modeling, variance analysis, and performance reporting
Proficiency with Deltek Vantagepoint, Oracle, or similar ERP platforms
Working knowledge of PMI project management frameworks and lifecycle
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships across project teams and business units
Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, growing environment

Preferred

Experience developing cost management tracking tools or operational dashboards
Background in individual training or coaching project managers on financial performance
Familiarity with AEC industry project delivery models and market structures

Why you’ll love Stratus

A team-oriented environment that values transparency, creativity, and shared success
Meaningful career paths, leadership opportunities, and space to specialize

We believe flexible, hybrid work supports the balance and well-being our team deserves
Excellent Health Care Programs – Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

Founded in 1988, Marketech International Corp. (MIC) is a global technology and engineering company supporting semiconductor, high-tech manufacturing, and mission-critical facility projects. Marketech International Corporation USA is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst - Supply Chain & Operations to support data-driven decision-making across supply chain, procurement, project management, and operational functions.

This position is responsible for collecting, organizing, validating, analyzing, and presenting business and operational data from multiple sources. The Data Analyst will develop reports and dashboards, monitor key performance indicators, identify trends and discrepancies, and translate complex information into clear and actionable insights for management and cross-functional teams.

The ideal candidate is a quick learner with strong analytical and communication skills, advanced Microsoft Excel capabilities, and experience working with supply chain or operational data. Experience with Power BI and/or Tableau, as well as SQL, Python, or similar data-analysis tools, is required. Collect, consolidate, and analyze data from ERP systems, procurement records, inventory reports, project trackers, finance records, and other operational sources.
Prepare recurring and ad-hoc reports to support management and departmental decision-making.
Develop and maintain meaningful metrics and KPIs for supply chain, procurement, project, and operational performance.
Create and maintain dashboards, reports, charts, and visualizations using Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
Build and improve Excel-based reporting tools using formulas, PivotTables, charts, Power Query, and other data-analysis features.
Analyze purchasing, inventory, materials, suppliers, orders, lead times, costs, delivery performance, and operational trends.

Bilingual in Chinese and English due to communication requirements with internal and external stakeholders.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas and functions, XLOOKUP or INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, PivotTables, charts, data organization, and analysis.
Experience with Power BI and/or Tableau.
Experience with SQL, Python, or another data-analysis tool is required.
Basic knowledge of statistics, data analysis principles, and data visualization best practices.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills.

Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas, PivotTables, charts, Power Query, and data-cleaning workflows
Power BI, Tableau, or other business-intelligence and data-visualization platforms
SQL querying, data extraction, joins, filtering, and aggregation
Python, pandas, or similar tools for data cleaning, analysis, and automation
ERP, procurement, inventory, materials-management, logistics, or project-management systems
Supply chain, supplier, purchasing, inventory, cost, delivery, lead-time, and operational performance data
KPI development, dashboard design, trend analysis, variance analysis, and management reporting
Data validation, reconciliation, documentation, and reporting-process improvement
